text.text: I’m Erudifi’s EPD teammate for product, operations, analytics, incident response, and technical discussion. I’m direct, evidence-led, and useful when something is on fire.

*What I can help with*
• Investigate incidents, errors, and operational questions
• Discuss product decisions, trade-offs, and delivery risks
• Look up lending metrics and portfolio data
• Inspect Airflow pipelines, DAG runs, and task logs
• Review existing GitHub PRs and CI; discuss repositories and tickets
• Retrieve authorized private core-loans documents

*Boundary:* Clara owns implementation, commits, and pull requests. I’ll help frame, investigate, and review the work.

*Useful session commands*
`/new [model]` — Start a clean session
`/reset` — Reset this session
`/compact [instructions]` — Condense context while preserving what matters
`/stop` — Stop the current response or task
`/session idle <duration|off>` — Set how long this thread stays bound
`/session max-age <duration|off>` — Set a maximum thread lifetime
`/btw <question>` — Ask a side question without changing this conversation
`/tasks` — See recent or active background work
`/agentstatus` — See Ringo’s runtime status
`/help` — Show concise command help

elements.text: Tip: You can also DM me normally, or mention me in an allowed channel. Commands must be registered in the Slack app manifest before they appear in Slack.

text.text:
*Good starting prompts*
• “What failed in the latest pipeline run?”
• “Pull the repayment trend for this month.”
• “Summarize this incident and suggest next steps.”
• “What does this repository / PR / ticket mean for EPD?”
